clips.title: The story
paras: The Grizzled Den is a cavern nestled in the snowy hills just southwest of Kharanos. It serves as a notorious lair for the ferocious, frost-breathing wendigos indigenous to Dun Morogh.

Carved deep into the crags southwest of Kharanos, the Grizzled Den is notorious among local mountaineers as the nesting ground of Dun Morogh's wendigo packs. These aggressive, ape-like beasts wield frosty breath against intruders and band together to protect their hollows. Despite the peril, daring hunters regularly brave the cavern's depths to harvest thick wendigo manes, which fetch a respectable sum among craftsmen looking to line cold chairs and carriage seats with insulated fur.

Beyond its fearsome inhabitants, the twisting tunnels of the Grizzled Den draw opportunists searching for natural wealth. Prospectors frequently venture past the outer entrance to hammer at copper veins jutting from the frozen stone walls, while adventurous scouts often scour the darker corners for discarded footlockers. However, delve too far into the inner reaches, and you are bound to face the dens' largest and most vicious predators lurking in the shadows.
